about: BABEL's factions in play (dungeon/factions.py), from dungeon/world/packages/babel/factions.json: the powers with a hand on the travel map, the clocks they run from arrival day, and the jobs they give. Holds are travel nodes (dungeon/world/data/travel/babel.json). Drafts for Vanta to keep, change or cut.

factions.name: The Landing
factions.summary: Darla Kinney's guild of veterans from before the Turning, small, poor and proud, living in a drained bathhouse at the end of the guild row.
goals: Get their people past Rank D under the new rules
Get leverage on the Turning before the big guilds do

clocks.name: Crack the Rank Trials
clocks.done: The Landing works out what the new Rank Trials want. Two of Darla's people pass to D in one week, and every guild on the row wants to know how.

clocks.name: Teague's eyes come back to the Landing
clocks.done: Darla stops pretending she does not see the white ring. She calls the one who wears it into the bathhouse and asks, flatly, what they remember about the Reach.

jobs.title: Escort a new wave to the cage
jobs.hook: The Landing needs a strong back to walk six frightened arrivals from the Waystone to Cobb's cage and see them onto Varrow before dark.
jobs.truth: Two of the six are Marked, and Darla knows what the Close does with the Marked. She is sending them anyway, because the Landing owes Varrow a debt in bodies.
jobs.missed: The six went up without an escort. Only four reached Hollin.

jobs.title: The empty bunk
jobs.hook: A Landing veteran wants someone to find out who took the kit from a bunk nobody sleeps in, and bring it back without telling Darla.
jobs.truth: The bunk was Teague's. Darla cleared it herself, and hid what she found in the bathhouse cistern.
jobs.missed: The kit stays lost. The veteran stops talking to the character.

factions.name: The market rows
factions.summary: Whoever collects the stall rent on the Concourse's fire-market rows, and remembers who was late.
goals: Know every new arrival worth something

clocks.name: A cart that can't pay its rent
clocks.done: The rows take Hamid's cart for back rent. His skewers turn up a week later on another man's grill, and Hamid turns up nowhere.

jobs.title: Collect from Hamid
jobs.hook: The rows want a climber to stand behind the collector while he leans on a skewer seller who is two weeks behind.
jobs.truth: Hamid is behind because he paid a dead climber's debt out of pity. The collector knows and is leaning harder for it.
jobs.missed: The collector went alone and broke Hamid's grill.

factions.name: The Close of Saint Aurel
factions.summary: Varrow's church on the white hill, which weighs every giant who comes up the Stair, keeps what the Scales find, and runs the Pens.
goals: Weigh every giant who comes up the Stair
Hold its compact with the Keep, on its own terms
Never let another Wakeful pass unweighed

clocks.name: The autumn weighing of Hollin
clocks.done: The Close comes down the hill with the Scales and weighs Hollin, door by door. Whoever is found wanting goes to the Pens, and the Keep does not stop it.

clocks.name: A new gift for the Wall
clocks.done: The Close gives a gift to the Wall: a Marked climber, bound, walked out to the Reachwall and left there for the giants.

jobs.title: The Pens ledger
jobs.hook: Brother Coll wants someone he does not know to copy a page of the Pens ledger, so it cannot be traced to him.
jobs.truth: The page shows where the Marked go after the Pens: down the Margrave's stair, sold, and the price is entered as a tithe.
jobs.missed: Coll copied it himself. He is not at the infirmary anymore.

factions.name: House Corve
factions.summary: The Margrave of Varrow and his household, who hold the Keep and the Reachwall and owe the Close more souls than he will pay.
goals: Hold the Wall under his own banner
Stop paying the Close in souls

clocks.name: Patch the Wall before the cold
clocks.done: The breach in the Reachwall is patched with timber and stone before the frost. It will hold one winter, and Captain Hode says so to the Margrave's face.

clocks.name: Refuse the tithe at the first frost
clocks.done: The Margrave refuses the Close its tithe in front of the whole valley. The bells stop, the Keep bars its gate, and Hollin has to pick a side.

jobs.title: A season on the Wall
jobs.hook: The Margrave is hiring climbers to stand his Wall until the first frost, paid in his coin, with his cellar stair at the end of it.
jobs.truth: The cellar stair goes up, past the Wall, toward the Marches. The Bishop went down it, and so did Teague.
jobs.missed: The Wall was short a pair of hands when the Reach came over.

factions.name: The Reach giants
factions.summary: Feral Nephil on the moor past the Reachwall, who remember a Wakeful who promised them the stair.
goals: Find the Wakeful who promised them the stair

clocks.name: The cold comes, and they come over
clocks.done: The first frost, and the Reach comes over the Wall in the dark. Men die on the patch. The giants call one name the whole night: Brother.

factions.name: The Lantern Room
factions.summary: Sabeen Oro's house under the Bazaar's great dome, which sells company, buys debts and collects them.
goals: Own the arrival who wrote the new rules

clocks.name: Fetch the engineer to the Lantern Room
clocks.done: Sabeen's runner brings the engineer up the Stair to the Bazaar, by a debt, a lie or a halter, and Sabeen sits him down and asks what the new rules are for.

jobs.title: A letter down the Stair
jobs.hook: Sabeen wants a sealed letter carried down to Hollin and put in one person's hand, and pays in advance.
jobs.truth: The letter is a contract with the reader's name already on it. Reading it to the end is signing.
jobs.missed: Sabeen sent her own runner instead, who carried more than a letter.

factions.name: The Copper Steps
factions.summary: The fences and rumor-brokers of the Bazaar's stair-gate, who buy every story about the Turning first.
goals: Buy every rumor about the Turning first

clocks.name: A bounty board goes down the chain
clocks.done: The Copper Steps post a bounty on the Bazaar's defaulters, and it goes down the Stair ahead of them, floor by floor.
